description: Search Reddit by keywords with advanced filters. Pro adds: subreddit filter/blocklist, dateFrom/dateTo, minScore, maxAgeDays, excludeNsfw, authorBlocklist, keywordRequireAll.

dateFrom.description: Drop posts with `created_at` before this date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Drop posts with `created_at` after this date (inclusive end-of-day). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

keywordRequireAll.description: When multiple keywords given, also dedupe & only emit posts whose title/content contains ALL of them. Default: each keyword runs independently (OR).
keywordRequireAll.title: Require all keywords (AND)

keywords.description: List of keywords to search. Each runs as a separate Reddit search.
keywords.title: Keywords

maxAgeDays.description: Drop posts older than N days.
maxAgeDays.title: Max post age in days (filter)

minScore.description: Drop posts with score below this number.
minScore.title: Min score (filter)

sort.description: How to sort the search results.
sort.title: Sort by

subredditFilter.description: Only emit posts from these subreddits (without `r/` prefix). Empty = all.
subredditFilter.title: Subreddit filter (allowlist)

title: Reddit Keywords Pro Input
